# volcenginecc_ecs_dedicated_host_cluster (Data Source)

Data Source schema for Volcengine::ECS::DedicatedHostCluster



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the dedicated host cluster.
- `dedicated_host_cluster_capacity` (Attributes) Capacity information of the dedicated host cluster, including available memory, available vCPU, supported instance types, and more. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dedicated_host_cluster_capacity))
- `dedicated_host_cluster_id` (String) ID of the dedicated host cluster.
- `dedicated_host_cluster_name` (String) Name of the dedicated host cluster. Length limit: 1–128 characters. Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.), and must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character.
- `dedicated_host_ids` (Set of String) List of IDs for all dedicated hosts contained in this dedicated host cluster.
- `description` (String) Description of the dedicated host cluster. Length limit: 0–256 characters.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the dedicated host cluster.
- `zone_id` (String) Availability zone ID to which the dedicated host cluster belongs. Cannot be modified after creation.

<a id="nestedatt--dedicated_host_cluster_capacity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dedicated_host_cluster_capacity`

Read-Only:

- `available_instance_types` (Attributes List) Supported instance types and the remaining number of instances that can be created for each type in this dedicated host cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dedicated_host_cluster_capacity--available_instance_types))
- `available_memory` (Number) Total remaining available memory in this dedicated host cluster, measured in GiB.
- `available_vcpus` (Number) Total remaining available vCPU count in this dedicated host cluster.
- `local_volume_capacities` (Attributes List) Available and total capacity of each type of local disk in this dedicated host cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dedicated_host_cluster_capacity--local_volume_capacities))
- `total_memory` (Number) Total memory of this dedicated host cluster, measured in GiB.
- `total_vcpus` (Number) Total vCPU count of this dedicated host cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--dedicated_host_cluster_capacity--available_instance_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dedicated_host_cluster_capacity.available_instance_types`

Read-Only:

- `available_capacity` (Number) Number of instances of this type that can still be created in the dedicated host cluster.
- `instance_type` (String) Instance type.


<a id="nestedatt--dedicated_host_cluster_capacity--local_volume_capacities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dedicated_host_cluster_capacity.local_volume_capacities`

Read-Only:

- `available_size` (Number) Remaining available capacity of this type of local disk, measured in GiB.
- `total_size` (Number) Total capacity of this type of local disk, measured in GiB.
- `volume_type` (String) Local disk type.
